title: One smart building described floor by floor, with an electrical cabinet on each floor
user_prompt: A smart building in France, with 7 floors, and in each floor 5 sensors + an electrical cabinet with an industrial PC and 5 merging units for handling the electrical protection. The sensors upload data to the cloud.

facts_if_asked.sensors: Temperature and presence sensors, about 0.5 W, a reading every 15 minutes of about 1 kB.
facts_if_asked.industrial PC: Fanless x86, 4 cores, 8 GB RAM, 128 GB SSD, about 25 W, supervises the protection locally.
facts_if_asked.merging units: IEC 61850 merging units, about 10 W each, talking only to the industrial PC.
facts_if_asked.cloud: An ingestion API and a time-series database on a public cloud.

expected_properties: Three levels of device groups: a building holding 7 floors, a floor holding 5 sensors and 1 electrical cabinet, a cabinet holding 1 industrial PC and 5 merging units; each group lists only what it directly holds, and the building names the floor (never the reverse).
One building in service as 2027 opens and none added: a single deployment of the building group, country FRANCE.
35 sensors, 7 industrial PCs and 35 merging units in service.
A sensor edge device and a merging unit edge device of kind appliance, an industrial PC of kind computer; cpu_cores_avg, ram_gb_avg and workload_fraction on edge functions, not on devices.
An edge function on the sensor with server_calls to an ingestion job and its database write; the PC and merging units make no server call the description does not state.
No web journey is required: the description names no user of a dashboard.
